title.zh: 一条时间线，也是一张听歌地图
title.en: A timeline you can listen your way through

lead.zh: 可以从一个时代进去，也可以从一件乐器、一个人或一场争论进去。每条都写清“发生了什么、改变了什么、现在还能听什么”。
lead.en: Enter through an era, an instrument, a person or an argument. Every entry says what happened, what changed and what you can still hear.

needs_title.en: Where do you want to enter

needs_sub.zh: 按时间、人物、流派、地域或问题进入，最后都能回到同一张地图。
needs_sub.en: Enter by period, person, genre, place or question; all routes return to the same map.

d.zh: 从早期到当代，每个时代先抓声响变化，再记年份。
d.en: From early music to now: hear the change in sound first, then remember the dates.

d.zh: 不只看出名与否，还看他们靠什么活着、在哪儿工作。
d.en: Not just fame: how they made a living and where they worked.

d.zh: 听它的节奏骨架、音色选择，以及它从谁那里长出来。
d.en: Hear its rhythmic skeleton, its timbral choices, and what it grew out of.

d.zh: 从劳动号子到宫廷乐器，听它们各自在什么场合活着。
d.en: From work songs to court instruments, each in the setting where it lived.

t.zh: 音乐是怎么被记录和卖出去的
t.en: How music was recorded and sold

d.zh: 记谱、录音、乐谱生意与经纪人，决定了什么能被留下来。
d.en: Notation, recording, sheet-music trade and agents decided what survived.

t.zh: 音乐和社会怎么互相塑形
t.en: Music and society shaping each other

d.zh: 国歌、抗议歌、宗教与移民，都是音乐进入公共生活的方式。
d.en: Anthems, protest songs, religion and migration are how music enters public life.

ladder_title.zh: 读一条历史条目的顺序
ladder_title.en: How to read a history entry

ladder_sub.zh: 先定位，再听声音，最后看它改写了什么。
ladder_sub.en: Locate it, hear it, then see what it rewrote.

d.zh: 同一件事在不同城市，意义完全不同。
d.en: The same event means something else in another city.

d.zh: 配器、音高与节奏，比形容词可靠。
d.en: Instrumentation, pitch and rhythm are more reliable than adjectives.

d.zh: 制度、听众与技术，往往一起变。
d.en: Institutions, audiences and technology usually change together.

d.zh: 同一时期、同一问题，换一个站继续读。
d.en: Same period, same question, continue on another site.

picks_sub.zh: 不是“最重要”，而是读完最容易接着往下走。
picks_sub.en: Not the most important, but the easiest to keep reading from.

why.zh: 三百年的记谱变化，决定我们今天怎么读音乐。
why.en: Three centuries of notation decide how we read music now.

why.zh: 录音把“一次演出”变成了可复制的东西。
why.en: Recording turned a performance into something copyable.

why.zh: 谁被写进历史，本身就是历史问题。
why.en: Who gets written into history is itself a historical question.

why.zh: 钱从哪来，决定了音乐长什么样。
why.en: Where the money came from shaped what the music could be.

why.zh: 一首歌怎么进入公共生活，又怎么被禁。
why.en: How a song enters public life, and how it gets banned.

why.zh: 人和声音一起移动，流派才不断混血。
why.en: People and sounds move together; genres keep mixing.

trails_sub.zh: 按顺序听，能听出风格的接缝。
trails_sub.en: Read in order and you can hear the seams between styles.

d.zh: 七个时期，一条声响变化的线索。
d.en: Seven periods, one thread of changing sound.

d.zh: 从乐谱生意到流媒体，媒介一直在改写作曲。
d.en: From sheet music to streaming, the medium keeps rewriting composition.

d.zh: 劳动、宫廷与地方乐种各自的声音。
d.en: The sounds of labour, court and regional traditions.
